midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, hero background, card borders, table rules — the structural near-black that anchors both dark and light regions

paper.$description: Paper — Page background, card surfaces, inverted button fill in dark hero

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle surface lift for secondary panels, table zebra rows, input wells

pearl.$description: Pearl — Quiet button backgrounds, nested surface tint

stone.$description: Stone — Table column dividers, neutral hairline borders

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Tinted table surface and the dominant data-grid border — a barely-violet line that sets the product interface apart from generic grays

mist.$description: Mist — Light borders on secondary controls, list separators

pewter.$description: Pewter — Medium cool border for outlined buttons and inputs

steel.$description: Steel — Cool gray border used at extremely high frequency (392) — the workhorse rule-line color for structural divisions

smoke.$description: Smoke — Icon stroke and muted body text on light surfaces

ash.$description: Ash — Muted icons, placeholder text, inactive controls

iron.$description: Iron — Body text secondary level, icon stroke weight

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary body text, supporting metadata

slate.$description: Slate — Strong secondary borders, card outline emphasis, footer text

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Deep text for body emphasis on light backgrounds

electric-iris.$description: Electric Iris — Brand accent — active tab indicator, step pill, the Enrich action, selected row check, brand wordmark dot — the single chromatic punctuation across an otherwise neutral system

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Muted action fill, secondary blue surfaces, desaturated hover state for the brand blue

hero-dawn.$description: Hero Dawn — Hero gradient terminus — the deepest point of the dark-to-light blue backdrop

sky-whisper.$description: Sky Whisper — Info badge background wash

sapphire-ink.$description: Sapphire Ink — Info badge dark text and border

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Success badge background wash

forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Green state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels.

sprout-whisper.$description: Sprout Whisper — Light success badge alternative background

saffron-whisper.$description: Saffron Whisper — Warning badge background wash

amber-ink.$description: Amber Ink — Warning badge dark text and border

blossom-whisper.$description: Blossom Whisper — Pink/magenta tag badge background — category label

mulberry-ink.$description: Mulberry Ink — Pink/magenta tag badge dark text and border

plum-ink.$description: Plum Ink — Deep violet tag badge dark text and border — alternative category color

crimson-ink.$description: Crimson Ink — Red state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels.

apricot-whisper.$description: Apricot Whisper — Orange/copper tag badge background

russet-ink.$description: Russet Ink — Orange/copper tag badge dark text and border

atacama-var.$description: Display serif for all section and hero headlines 44px and above — the editorial weight 317–370 reads as research-journal rather than marketing, and the -0.06em tracking tightens the wide capitals into a confident mass

pp-neue-montreal.$description: Workhorse UI font — body copy, buttons, nav, badges, table cells, and pre-headline labels. The 450 weight (a rare half-step) is the default for interactive elements, sitting between regular and medium for restraint

inter.$description: Secondary UI text — tight table cells, micro-labels, and dense numerical columns where PP Neue Montreal is swapped for the slightly narrower Inter to save horizontal space

suisse-intl.$description: Rarely used body fallback, appears in micro-copy where 0.08em letter-spacing creates a quiet institutional voice
